title: Cued Recall of Paired Associates with Open-Loop Stimulation at Encoding or Retrieval
description: This dataset provides intracranial EEG recordings and behavioral events from a cued recall paired-associates memory task with open-loop electrical stimulation. Participants studied word pairs, completed an arithmetic distractor, and then performed cued recall. Stimulation was delivered to single hippocampal or entorhinal electrodes during either encoding or retrieval. Data were collected at clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania.
methods_description: Each session comprised 25 lists of encoding (6 word pairs, 4000 ms each), arithmetic distractor, and cued recall (5000 ms per cue). Twenty lists per session were stimulation lists, 10 with stimulation at encoding and 10 at retrieval, on alternating pairs or cues, and 5 lists had no stimulation. Stimulation began 200 ms before stimulus onset and lasted 4.6 s. Stimulation parameters are recorded in the events files. Recordings were made with Blackrock or Medtronic systems, with monopolar and bipolar montages provided.
